description:
The process starts when a company schedules a compliance audit for regulations such as ISO standards, safety protocols, or environmental guidelines.
Internal teams prepare documentation, gather evidence, and conduct a self-assessment before the external audit.
Auditors review the company's processes and identify any gaps or issues.
After making the necessary corrections or improvements, the company undergoes a final audit.
If all criteria are met, the company is awarded certification, and the process concludes with the issuance of official documents.

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL"
                  xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance"
                  targetNamespace="http://example.com/compliance-audit">
  <bpmn:process id="Process_ComplianceAudit" name="Compliance audit and certification" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_ComplianceAuditScheduled" name="Compliance audit scheduled">
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Start_PrepareDocumentation</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:startEvent>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_PrepareDocumentation" name="Prepare documentation">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Start_PrepareDocumentation</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Prepare_GatherEvidence</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_GatherEvidence" name="Gather evidence">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Prepare_GatherEvidence</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Gather_SelfAssessment</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_ConductSelfAssessment" name="Conduct self-assessment">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Gather_SelfAssessment</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_SelfAssessment_ReviewProcesses</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_ReviewProcesses" name="Review company processes">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_SelfAssessment_ReviewProcesses</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Review_IdentifyGaps</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_IdentifyGaps" name="Identify gaps or issues">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Review_IdentifyGaps</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Identify_Correct</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_MakeCorrections" name="Make corrections or improvements">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Identify_Correct</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Correct_FinalAudit</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_ConductFinalAudit" name="Conduct final audit">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Correct_FinalAudit</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_FinalAudit_CriteriaGateway</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_CriteriaMet" name="Are all criteria met?" gatewayDirection="Diverging">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_FinalAudit_CriteriaGateway</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_CriteriaMet_Award</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_CriteriaNotMet_End</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_AwardCertification" name="Award certification">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_CriteriaMet_Award</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Award_IssueDocuments</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_IssueDocuments" name="Issue official documents">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Award_IssueDocuments</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Issue_CertificationEnd</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_CertificationIssued" name="Certification documents issued">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Issue_CertificationEnd</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>

    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_CriteriaNotMet" name="Final audit criteria not met">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_CriteriaNotMet_End</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Start_PrepareDocumentation" sourceRef="Start_ComplianceAuditScheduled" targetRef="Task_PrepareDocumentation"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Prepare_GatherEvidence" sourceRef="Task_PrepareDocumentation" targetRef="Task_GatherEvidence"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Gather_SelfAssessment" sourceRef="Task_GatherEvidence" targetRef="Task_ConductSelfAssessment"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SelfAssessment_ReviewProcesses" sourceRef="Task_ConductSelfAssessment" targetRef="Task_ReviewProcesses"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Review_IdentifyGaps" sourceRef="Task_ReviewProcesses" targetRef="Task_IdentifyGaps"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Identify_Correct" sourceRef="Task_IdentifyGaps" targetRef="Task_MakeCorrections"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Correct_FinalAudit" sourceRef="Task_MakeCorrections" targetRef="Task_ConductFinalAudit"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_FinalAudit_CriteriaGateway" sourceRef="Task_ConductFinalAudit" targetRef="Gateway_CriteriaMet"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_CriteriaMet_Award" name="All criteria met" sourceRef="Gateway_CriteriaMet" targetRef="Task_AwardCertification">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">all criteria are met</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_CriteriaNotMet_End" name="Criteria not met" sourceRef="Gateway_CriteriaMet" targetRef="End_CriteriaNotMet"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Award_IssueDocuments" sourceRef="Task_AwardCertification" targetRef="Task_IssueDocuments"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Issue_CertificationEnd" sourceRef="Task_IssueDocuments" targetRef="End_CertificationIssued"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
